comparison.objective: Candidate extracts a locked terminal; record tightens and seats a bracket bolt in confined access.
comparison.physical_skill: Single-blade latch depression with wire deflection and simultaneous withdrawal versus socket engagement and repeated ratchet drive/return cycles.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires damage-free selective release, with force limits not yet measured. Record requires bolt advance, seated gap, socket engagement, six ratchet cycles, and torque below 1 N m.
comparison.reason: Confined tool access is shared, but release-by-tab and threaded fastening with a one-way clutch are different tested mechanisms.
